description: Internal heartbeat message for monitoring agent health and status

pid.description: Process ID of the sending agent

custom_methods.name: getTaskStatusString
custom_methods.body: const char* statuses[] = {"NotStarted", "Starting", "Running", "Paused", "Stopping", "Stopped", "Timeout", "Failed", "Crashed"}; return (task_status_ >= 0 && task_status_ <= 8) ? statuses[task_status_] : "UNKNOWN";

custom_methods.name: getSystemModeString
custom_methods.body: const char* modes[] = {"STARTING_UP", "STANDBY", "VIEWFINDER", "CALIBRATION", "LAUNCH_MONITOR", "DIAGNOSTIC"}; return (system_mode_ >= 0 && system_mode_ <= 5) ? modes[system_mode_] : "UNKNOWN";

notes: Simple heartbeat message for agent health monitoring
